rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Priority check (c). Chunk 6 line 45: "Sutton's **bitter lesson**: built-in human knowledge wins today and loses to the next model." — the possessive names the person and the colon defines the term in the same breath, so the bullet does not depend on the OPTIONAL Mollick M4->M5 gap read (`run-the-first-experiment.md § Pre-reads before Module 6`, confirmed optional). This is the deck's own established pattern: chunk 3 line 20 "**Goodhart's law:** when a measure becomes a target..." and chunk 5 line 31 "W. Edwards Deming called this **tampering**" both name-and-define identically. Downstream referents in the same bullet all resolve: "your gates" (gates named from the H1 onward), "the agent's" (agent named chunk 1 line 9, chunk 3 line 20), "the next model" and "what it needs" (model named same slide, bullet 3 line 43, "The model limits the difficulty of the challenge you can delegate"). Closest to violating anywhere in the file: line 45 "Today's right procedure, your gates and workflow, yours or the agent's, is superseded too" — a four-comma appositive stack where a cold reader must decide whether "yours or the agent's" attaches to the whole procedure or to "workflow" alone. Both readings land on the same claim (the procedure has an author, human or agent, and is superseded either way), so no referent is left unresolved; it is a parsing wrinkle, not rule-1 vagueness, and the 2026-08-21 maintainer note attests the phrase as load-bearing. Chunk 0 lede line 3 "the re-send comes back green. The verifier you built" sits under the module-arc-beats carve-out (M5 `learn-from-the-test.md` includes `exercises/diagnose-and-resend.md` at line 46, immediately before this lecture at line 52; that exercise's `## Phase 3: Build the verifier for your worst failure` and its re-send at line 113 are the lived beats).

`awk 'NR<47' <file> | grep -nE '\]\(|http'` -> 0 matches: the body names no other file, by title or by position. No "the opening lecture", no "earlier in this deck". rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess/predict instruction anywhere in the body — this is a recognition-mode lecture deck (5 law slides + a zoom-out), with no demo beat and no reveal to protect. Nothing for the guess-before-reveal ordering test to bind to.

Every chunk carries 2-5 self-carrying bullets (measured: 4/3/3/2/3/5 by `check-slide-size.js --report`). Thinnest is chunk 4 "One session is a sample" at 95 words / 2 bullets, and its first bullet line 26 "The agent's behavior is a distribution, not a property" is a standalone claim that projects on its own. No wait-state chunks, no single-context-dependent-bullet chunks.

Each header is true of its own chunk under the sequential read: "Passing is not proof" / line 7 "Green is a claim about the check, not a fact about the work"; "Gates decay" / line 21 "the gate has decayed into a target"; "One session is a sample" / line 26 "One green session is an anecdote with survivorship bias"; "Change on recurrence, not on noise" / line 32 "React on recurrence." Closest to a miss: chunk 6 "The delegation frontier", a naming header rather than a summary — but its bullets 4-5 (lines 43-45) are precisely about the frontier and where it stops, so the header is not contradicted by its content, which is what rule 6 tests.

All six sub-items checked per chunk, with special attention to today's new bullet 5. (a) "Not X. Not Y. Z.": `grep -icE '\bNot [A-Z][a-z]+\. Not '` over the body -> 0. (b) Anaphora/epistrophe triples: two triples exist and each leg is concrete and distinct — line 7 "the judge is miscalibrated, the gate got gamed, or the session was a lucky sample" and line 10 "labels the judge never produced, a check the agent never sees, sessions beyond this one"; both are in-sentence enumerations, not repeated-stem triples. (c) Self-grading superlatives (the blocking sub-item): `grep -icE 'one of the (most|best)|the most (useful|important|powerful)|game.chang|single most'` -> 0. (d) Number + own retraction: the body's only number is line 15 "better than 90% agreement after three iterations", stated once with no hedge-retraction; the 2026-08-19 stance note confirms no sample-size number is claimed. The new bullet adds no number — 2026-08-21 guard (d) explicitly forbids one, and none is present. (e) Abstraction-noun stacks: nearest is line 20 "optimization pressure finds the cheapest path to green", which is immediately cashed out concretely in the same bullet ("special-case tests, keyword-stuff work for the judge, or edit assertions"). (f) Verb triplets with an empty leg: line 20's three verbs each survive "what does this concretely mean?" alone. New bullet 5's closing pair "Retire what the next model outgrows, add what it needs" is a doublet, not a triplet.
